text: Assumption: The provision of the data in the buffer BufferPtr is completed asynchronously after function return — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The provision of the data in the buffer BufferPtr is completed asynchronously after function return — is this correct?
norm: the provision of the data in the buffer bufferptr is completed asynchronously after function return
assumption: The provision of the data in the buffer BufferPtr is completed asynchronously after function return.
rationale: SWS_EthIf_91133 specifies the function as asynchronous and E_OK purely as successful triggering ("read was triggered successfully"), without mentioning an explicit synchronous copy operation or callback.

original.text: Annahme: Die Bereitstellung der Daten im Puffer BufferPtr dürfte asynchron nach Funktionsrückkehr abgeschlossen werden — trifft das zu?
